name: autocommit
description: Batch changes from overlapping Codex sessions into automatic Git commits.

interface.shortDescription: Batch session changes into Git commits.
interface.longDescription: Codex Autocommit collects changes from concurrent and sequential Codex sessions, summarizes completed work in the background, and commits the combined working tree as soon as no active session has uncommitted writes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the current Codex autocommit batch status.
